      <span class="ws-block-note">fill from a dated quote; no vendor price is pre-filled</span></h2>

      The budget conversation that matters isn't "what does the tool cost?" but
      "what does the tool cost relative to the developer time it displaces, and
      does the enterprise tier's governance premium justify avoiding the shadow
      IT remediation cost?" (ch02 L142-146)
    </p>

    <div class="prior--hedged">
      <span class="hedge-figure">2–4× the individual price</span>
      <span class="hedge-text">Enterprise tiers that add governance, SSO, and audit controls typically run 2–4× the individual price, depending on the vendor.</span>

    </div>
